readme_row: | `Causal.HalfLitDual` | — | ETT programme, layer 1 (T-abs-halflit-dual-separates): the time-reversed half-lit line `halfLightLine.dual`, absolutely minimal on every open set for every cover, causally arc-connected, globally hyperbolic (hence causally compact), push-up, strongly causal in both forms, a time function (`−id`, through the new `Causality.dual_hasTimeFunction`); neither causally open in the future nor locally so (`causal_ladder`: absolute minimality and ¬ causally open in the future; at `0` no open set is), nor two-sided, not tarentin, no chronal neighbours, not plain; conjoined in `halfLightLine_dual_separates_causallyOpenFuture`, valid in either reading of `defi:causalite`; 2026-11-21 |
kb_proposals: 0090 (or the next free id), pattern — The time-reversed half-lit line: `halfLightLine.dual` has the half-lit line's ladder facts with the time-oriented ones exchanged: absolutely minimal on every open set for every cover (`halfLightLine_dual_absolutelyMinimalOn`), causally arc-connected, GH, push-up, open strong causality, a time function (−id); neither causally open in the future nor locally so (no open set containing 0 is, `halfLightLine_not_causallyOpenPastOn_of_zero_mem`). `Causal.halfLightLine_dual_separates_causallyOpenFuture` (`Causal.HalfLitDual`) is the either-reading witness for causally_arc_connected, causally_compact, globally_hyperbolic ⇏ (locally_)causally_open_future (T-abs-halflit-dual-separates).

pattern — A time-reversed witness: transport the base facts with the `dual_*` iff lemmas in `have`s (HasTimeFunction has one since T-abs-halflit-dual-separates, `Causality.dual_hasTimeFunction`, by T ↦ −T), then `causal_ladder` on the term `C.dual` derives the rest as for any causality (its rules match `?C := C.dual`); it never crosses from `C` to `C.dual` itself (kb/0048) (T-abs-halflit-dual-separates).
